records.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Repair production PIXEL GAME TOKEN for 모르도르 오크(검) (orc_sword). Image 1 is the ORIGINAL identity, equipment, pose, action and silhouette. Image 2 controls crisp pixel clusters, short color ramps, stepped dark outline, elevated front camera and lowered head only; DO NOT copy its costume/weapon. Image 3 if supplied is species ANATOMY proportions only, never transfer its pose or gray clothes. Start from original action and EXACT weapon/shield/banner/staff/bow placement and relative size; preserve original body lean and hand grips, no generic pose substitution, no missing or invented gear. Repair stated defect: 열린 투구·얼굴 시점과 머리/하체 비중을 재검수해야 함.. ORC/URUK: anatomy and skull/body proportions from third standard ORC reference, retaining individual source build, neither chibi nor tall human. Camera high-angle FRONT looking DOWN45degrees over the WHOLE body, crown and shoulder tops visible; still front-facing, not top-down, side or rear. Chin and gaze point gently downward like original; face mostly hidden under hair/hood/helmet, no looking at viewer. Preserve original unique silhouette, material colors and heraldry. Crisp deliberate PIXEL artwork, not smooth painting/3D. Entire character/mount/all appendages and equipment inside INNER80percent of transparent canvas, broad empty margins, body centered excluding weapons. No floor, base, scenery, cast shadow, haze, glow, text or UI. Output ONLY this one original subject.
records.notes: 기존 닫힌 투구·곡검·철 갑주를 보존해 열린 투구와 정면 얼굴 노출을 수정. 숙인 머리, 분리된 무릎·발목과 전진 다리 연결을 비교함.
